page.title: Day 3 — the emphasis Neave set and the site lost
page.standfirst_html:
183 of the corpus's 629 lost runs sit on Day 3 — 29% of the backlog, and the lowest alignment of the twelve days at 86%. Every finding below was read against the source page image: pdftotext discards emphasis entirely, so the image is the only place these claims can be checked at all.

Accepting every proposal here takes Day 3 to 183 → 0 lost runs, 18 → 0 added and 4 → 2 swapped, measured by re-running the checker against a copy of the day with all of them applied. The two that survive are the two cards below marked No defect — which is the check that the record and the adjudication agree.

The Restore italics group is the bulk of it, and each card there opens already set to Restore — skim them for exceptions. The Fix proposed group is where judgment is actually needed: emphasis the site added, spans that start or stop in the wrong place, and three runs no check can see. Nothing is preset there.
